main_body: Two wooden posts with a cloth hammock sagging between them, seen as a side-on U-shaped curve
top_band: none: the cloth is a curved profile 1px light edge then cream/grey bands that follow the sag; the post tops are 1-2px caps with no visible horizontal surface
evidence: The posts are flat vertical strips with only a 1-2px highlight at their tops, so no beam or cap top face is visible from above. The hammock is a front/side profile curve: the column scan shows a 1px highlight, then bands of the same cream family running downward, with no horizontal top surface and no separate front face. The base of each post is a plain foot with no top face. This is a side elevation of a sagging cloth and the posts show no 3/4 surfaces.

style.evidence: The cloth has about 5 steps from cream highlight to grey-brown shadow, and the posts have 4-5 orange-brown steps. The outline is a tinted dark brown or taupe, with 0% neutral edge pixels. Flat-fill coverage is 0%. With 12 colours per tile it is somewhat below the references (17 and 20) and has only 16 distinct colours against 38-40, so it looks simpler. The posts are smooth vertical gradients with little grain, and the cloth has no weave or fold texture. Next to the stall and well it looks thinner but still clean and in style, so it passes narrowly.
